newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo closes off lows vs mark in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Escudo closes off lows vs mark in light trade.

text.p: 1648 GMT - The escudo closed off the lows against the mark in light trade after dropping to 101.14 per mark as it tracked a peseta faced with a weakening dollar. The Bank of Portugal was not seen intervening in the market, dealers said. They said the escudo would continue to be affected by other currencies, namely the peseta and the franc, in a range between 101.00 and 101.10 per mark. The escudo closed at 101.02/05 per mark, compared with 101.03/06 at the opening.
